facts.business: Maithan Alloys Limited manufactures and sells manganese-based ferro alloys for the steel industry.

auditor.name: Singhi & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Notes 2 and 57 regarding Basis of Preparation due to merger of Impex Metal & Ferro Alloys Limited with appointed date March 31, 2024, effective June 30, 2026.

key_risks: Manganese ore price volatility due to demand/supply changes; over 90% of manganese ore imported.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with Maithan Ferrous Private Limited (subsidiary) for sourcing raw materials, store items, consumables, and supplying finished goods; all at arm's length. No other materially significant related party transactions.
